## Goal
Idempotent scripts create the whole telephony path; the worker deploys to ECS.

## Owns
- `scripts/livekit/**`
- `scripts/telnyx/**`
- `infra/cdk/lib/voice-stack.ts`
- `engines/livekit-agent/Dockerfile`

## Tests first (write them, see them fail, then implement)
- Scripts are idempotent (second run makes no changes) — test with recorded API fixtures.

## Steps
- Inbound trunk (all numbers on the connection), dispatch rule individual rooms + agent "frontdesk", outbound trunk with Telnyx credentials.
- Telnyx FQDN connection to LiveKit SIP and a credential connection for outbound.
- ECS service: graceful drain on deploy (finish calls).

## Acceptance
- A real call to a dev number reaches the worker (with E8).

`pnpm vitest run scripts` and `make test` before opening the PR.
